notes.title: Update - Dec 8
notes.content:
Mouse responsiveness fixed - mouse sensitivity was wrong unless game was running at 60 FPS.
New menu fonts used.

notes.title: Public beta #1
notes.content:
Wing Breakers open beta is now live all the time.
New features:
- multiplayer Elo ratings added. Position matters, not just winning.
- multiplayer badges
- incoming missile warning system
- flying assist for beginners improved
- controllers fixed (dual shock, xbox 360)
- bug fixes

notes.title: Update October 15th
notes.content:
Campaign jobs added - currently demo includes 5 tasks.
Controller fixes - better support for Direct Input.
Plane boost is now faster to activate.
Menu / bug fixes

notes.title: Update October 8th
notes.content:
Bug fixes related to the feedback from first beta weekend.

Fixed support for Steam input, Dualshock, XBox 360 controllers, mouse sensitivity.
A couple of crashing bugs.
New campaign modes and multiplayer event style.
